acquisition.default_sampling: Four seeded 12-row windows across the viewer split; cluster sample, not representative quality estimate
acquisition.hq_sampling: One seeded shard among the first 100 listed files of each of six crawls; remaining pages not enumerated; cluster convenience sample

score_cutoff_check.interpretation: Document retention only; not retained tokens or a quality result. Preserve lower-score coverage for inspection.

sample_token_serialization: Unchanged content, frozen Mistral SentencePiece, BOS and EOS per document; sample tokens only, not eligible stock

rubric: Information density and useful domain diversity
Separate factual correctness from presentation quality

observations.observation: Complete short argumentative passage; distinguish perspective from general scientific exposition. No extraction defect observed.
observations.limitation: No external factual verification; source-use and exclusions remain open.

observations.observation: Coherent dated report with formatting and grammar noise; preserves numerical and geographic claims.
observations.limitation: Claims were not checked; educational score is not a correctness certificate.

observations.observation: Substantive biographical opening but large unrelated navigation/article directory at the tail.
observations.limitation: Excerpt review; strip verified navigation only, preserving historical prose and attribution.

observations.observation: Structured long lecture with attribution and course context, readable beginning and end.
observations.limitation: Only head/tail reviewed; continuity and middle content remain unchecked.

observations.observation: Intact agenda but sparse knowledge and unresolved references to Terms of Reference; classifier score 0.9733 does not establish high information density.
observations.limitation: Do not discard all short procedural documents; keep as a coverage/utility contrast.

observations.observation: Coherent overview of research programmes, with specific named projects and readable paragraphs.
observations.limitation: Origin unresolved in the released fields; cannot promote to eligible bank from text alone.

observations.observation: Substantive exposition and bibliography, navigation preamble and explicit Wikipedia-derived attribution footer.
observations.limitation: Preserve attribution and resolve original page/version; excerpt review does not validate scientific claims.

observations.observation: Mostly module teaser questions, with empty reading-time labels; little actual instruction.
observations.limitation: No operational safety assessment; distinguish intact short descriptions from substantive learning content.

observations.observation: Readable modern-slavery policy, but generic repeated commitments illustrate that score 0.9971 need not mean technical depth.
observations.limitation: No check of the firm or legal claims; count template families before giving this genre much weight.

observations.observation: Head/tail repeatedly restate topic and importance; detailed financial claims need separate verification.
observations.limitation: Excerpt-based utility concern; no claim that facts are correct/incorrect or that text is synthetic.

observations.observation: Prose references a metric, perturbation, wave equation and strain value where displayed expressions are missing. Score 0.9557 did not prevent this visible extraction loss.
observations.limitation: Reject this serialization for the technical bank; recover equations from traceable origin if feasible, preserving scientific topic coverage. Middle not fully reviewed.

validation.offline_replay: Identical sample bytes and census/metadata/token results, excluding output path
validation.fineweb_sample_tokens: All 64 match retained document-index token counts
validation.cross_source_scope: Six HQ shards, 48 default rows, 64 FineWeb-Edu samples only; not whole-corpus overlap

decision.basis: Observed original-page/WARC metadata makes lineage and extraction recovery more tractable; quality superiority not established.
decision.default: Keep comparison evidence; require demonstrated original-FineWeb identity/content join before promotion to a provenance-resolved bank.
decision.v1_4: Not inspected or conflated with either route.
decision.license: Pinned publisher card says Apache-2.0 for the project and instructs checking component dataset licenses; no per-document license clearance follows from metadata.
decision.next: Complete HQ shard inventory; design score/crawl/host/length-stratified source inspection and origin/family deduplication; retain intact scientific/technical material and repair extraction where possible. Then add bounded DCLM control before source allocation freeze.
decision.unchanged: Model, eight-bank weights, token goals, pilot, evaluation and GPU budget.

limitations: Diagnostics are review hints, not rejection or factual correctness.
Exact overlap is limited to six HQ shards, 48 default documents and 64 retained control samples; no near-duplicate or parent-stock matching.
Classifier scores across sources are not calibrated to each other.
HQ first-page shard selection and viewer windows do not establish domain representativeness.
Language labels are upstream, not independent language verification.
No bulk-source license clearance, training exclusion screen, eligible-token count or model comparison.
No quality or benchmark comparison across these differently sampled populations.
No 32K/128K source-supply qualification from these samples.
No repeated full-corpus scan or GPU experiment was needed.
